name: merge (newest-ML x life/culture, R11)
bias_applied: stage2_prefer_buildable_artifact_over_grand_unification=true — every merge is a codeable method + test protocol, not a grand theorem.

merges.name: Coppice-GA
merges.transferred_mechanism: Coppicing releases dormant lateral buds by cutting the dominant apex; map onto optimizer-search by benching the top-fitness genome for 1 generation after it has held rank-1 for K generations (dominance-triggered, not random restart), releasing suppressed sub-dominant primitive combinations.
merges.buildable_artifact: Coppice-GA over the 2512.11853 genome encoding; trigger when top-1 holds rank K gens; measure genome diversity + held-out acc on CIFAR-10/ViT-Tiny vs standard/random-restart GA.
merges.novelty_guess: dominance-triggered periodic best-exclusion absent from NAS/AutoML

merges.name: EtakLR
merges.transferred_mechanism: Etak coarsens continuous dead-reckoning into discrete sector crossings; map onto LR schedule by binning cheap sharpness (power-iteration <5 passes) into 3-4 log-spaced stability sectors and firing easy->hard phase transitions on sector crossings (noise-robust, 1 hyperparam).
merges.buildable_artifact: EtakLR controller; ResNet-50/ImageNet + GPT-2/wikitext, sweep batch {256,1024,4096}; vs fixed-epoch optimal-control schedule + continuous sharpness-adaptive.
merges.novelty_guess: sector-lattice sharpness trigger for LR phase switch not in adaptive-schedule literature

merges.name: Adaptive-Fenwick LogLinear
merges.transferred_mechanism: Etak sector crossings are threshold- not clock-driven; replace Log-Linear Attention's fixed power-of-2 Fenwick promotion boundaries with learned per-level cosine-similarity thresholds (content-gated 'sector crossing'), keeping O(log T) state count.
merges.buildable_artifact: Add per-level threshold vector to 2506.04761; gated promotion on cos_sim>theta_k; PG-19 perplexity + MQAR recall @512/2048/8192; profile to confirm log cost.
merges.novelty_guess: content-gated vs power-of-2 Fenwick partition not in the Log-Linear Attention paper

merges.name: Kigumi-VLA
merges.transferred_mechanism: Kigumi joints tighten under the load they resist; make VLA's adaptive penalty load-proportional: lambda_t = lambda_0*(1+alpha*||S_t||_F), so a fuller memory resists new writes harder via the same Sherman-Morrison path (2 scalars, spectral-norm-1 preserved).
merges.buildable_artifact: Modify 2605.11196 penalty schedule; MQAR @512-4096 (memory-saturation regime) + 10x overwrite stress test; confirm Jacobian spectral norm <=1 analytically.
merges.novelty_guess: load-proportional penalty lambda_t∝||S_t||_F not in the VLA paper

merges.name: Kotekan Dual-Head Drafting
merges.transferred_mechanism: Kotekan = two incomplete interlocking parts whose rests are the other's notes; train two PARD-COD draft heads with complementary even/odd future-offset masks, run on separate CUDA streams, interleave -> double draft depth at unchanged per-head latency.
merges.buildable_artifact: Dual-head COD recipe on AMD-AGI/PARD ('kotekan_mode'); LLaMA-3.1-8B MT-Bench/HumanEval; accepted-tokens/sec vs single-head PARD at matched params.
merges.novelty_guess: even/odd complementary-mask draft heads not in PARD/EAGLE/Medusa (Medusa heads are redundant, not partitioned)

merges.name: Entropy-Gated VeriCache
merges.transferred_mechanism: Etak triggers a calibration reset on sector crossing (content-driven, not fixed distance); replace VeriCache's fixed-token verify trigger with a cumulative draft-entropy accumulator that fires full-KV swap+verify on threshold crossing -> verify cadence proportional to content difficulty.
merges.buildable_artifact: Entropy-gated scheduler (<50 lines) on 2605.17613 draft loop; HumanEval vs open-ended long-form; measure correction rate + wasted swap cycles vs fixed-interval.
merges.novelty_guess: entropy-gated verify applied to verify-against-offloaded-full-cache setting not published

merges.name: Global Advantage Fallow
merges.transferred_mechanism: Subak pest control needs landscape-scale SIMULTANEOUS fallow (partial fallow lets pests migrate); ProGRPO's per-minibatch reweighting is a 'local fallow' -> add a Global Advantage Fallow: every K steps freeze ALL rollout streams, pool perplexity/confidence globally, refit reweighting, resume; dominant mode can't migrate across minibatch boundaries.
merges.buildable_artifact: GAF scheduler on a GRPO trainer; 7B on MATH-500, sweep K{50,100,200}, budget beta{0.05,0.10}; self-BLEU + KL-from-uniform over correct paths at fixed accuracy vs baseline ProGRPO.
merges.novelty_guess: periodic global gradient-freeze+recalibrate for advantage reweighting not in ProGRPO/MASPO/DAPO (all single-minibatch)

merges.name: LoadTightening AutoTTS
merges.transferred_mechanism: Kigumi encodes load-tightening into geometry at fabrication time; constrain AutoTTS's synthesized TTS controllers so stop/prune thresholds are PROVABLY monotone in accumulated resource use (tokens, depth, branch count) — load-tightening as a hard code-structure constraint, not an empirical heuristic.
merges.buildable_artifact: LoadTighteningController base class on zhengkid/AutoTTS (monotonicity unit-tested in replay env); vs baseline CMC controller across 4 backbones, beta in [0.3,0.7]; token-efficiency variance across difficulty; ablate monotonicity.
merges.novelty_guess: load-tightening as a hard synthesis constraint (vs empirical CMC) not in AutoTTS

diversity_note: Merge agents independently over-concentrated on versatile 'computationally juicy' life concepts (Etak x3, Kigumi x2) -> only 5/24 distinct used. Queued for params: add a distinct-life-concept-per-merge constraint / intra-cycle diversity filter next cycle. Sibling merges (3 Etak, 2 Kigumi) will compete at niche/value stages.
